text:
David Livingston shares series of tweets commenting on Democrats and future elections
By
B. S. MartinDavid Livingston, a Republican elected to the Arizona State House in 2023 representing the 28th District, posted a series of tweets on July 15, 2026, addressing political themes and referencing the Democratic Party.
At 21:17 UTC, Livingston posted "2028 https://t.co/l8U02uZdFZ". One minute later, he tweeted "Today's democrats https://t.co/uN3SxdcMrd", followed by another post at 21:19 UTC stating "Today's democrats https://t.co/hM9VzlMIKM".
Livingston has served as a state legislator since his election in 2023, when he succeeded Kelli Butler as the representative for Arizona's 28th House District. His social media activity frequently addresses contemporary political issues and party dynamics.
